$comment: Environment variables this brick depends on. Read by `fonderie env`, the admin console and check:env-declarations — docs/ENV-DECLARATIONS-DESIGN.md

vars.name: NODE_ENV
vars.description: Runtime mode. production arms boot errors for an unwired receipt path.

vars.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
vars.description: Signing secret of the Stripe endpoint for /billing/webhook (whsec_…). Unset: renewals and cancellations never sync.

vars.name: PUBLIC_API_URL
vars.description: This API's public URL, so the doctor can check Stripe's webhook registration.

vars.name: STRIPE_WALLET_WEBHOOK_SECRET
vars.description: Signing secret of the Stripe endpoint for /billing/webhook/payment. Separate from the subscription one.

vars.name: ADMIN_TOKEN
vars.description: Bearer token guarding plan writes and wallet grants. Unset: those routes are not mounted. Shared by every brick that has an admin surface.
